title: Change affirmative olla into negative
focus: Keep the subject and context while changing only the polarity pattern.

exercises.prompt: Change Minä olen paikalla. “I am present.” → ____ “I am not present.” Keep the subject and context unchanged.
exercises.explanation: Minä changes from olen to en ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.

Correct. Minä changes from olen to en ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.
“Sinä et ole paikalla.” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä changes from olen to en ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.
“Minä ei olen paikalla.” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä changes from olen to en ole. The negative verb carries the person ending.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject + person-marked negative verb + ole + context

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: negative verb: carries the person agreement
parts.formation: minä takes the negative-verb form en

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: olla uses the fixed form ole after the negative verb

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: supplied as a complete fixed expression; no change is required
